monitor.onlineHint: Online indicates network presence. Active traffic and service health are separate signals.
monitor.truncated: List limited to the first results; see totals above.
monitor.cpuHint: CPU per core: multithreaded processes can exceed 100%. Read and write measure activity, not occupied space.
monitor.diskAlert: Attention: space or inode usage exceeds 85%.
monitor.directoryHint: Authorized directory totals, updated every 5 minutes. Symlinks and other filesystems are excluded. These do not account for the entire disk.
monitor.diskHint: To identify current writers, sort processes by write rate. Docker usage appears in Resources and container details.
monitor.connectionHint: TCP/UDP sockets do not identify people. Per-IP traffic is not inferred from connection counts. Virtual interfaces may count the same traffic.
monitor.noSessions: No terminal sessions reported by the system.
monitor.noEvents: No recognized events in the queried window.
monitor.accessHint: Sessions come from system accounting; connections without a terminal may be absent. SSH attempts depend on journal availability. Application access has no structured source yet.
monitor.containerHint: CPU and memory come from Docker. Read/write are cumulative counters since the container started.
monitor.serviceHint: Running indicates process state. Health is only known when the container provides a healthcheck; endpoint availability has not been tested.
monitor.backupHint: Results are shown per target. A successful backup does not clear a different target's failure.
monitor.logHint: Space occupied by local log files and available rotations; contents are never read. External drivers or unsupported paths have no size. Collected every 5 minutes.
